en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small harbor with wooden piers, several rowing boats in the foreground, sailing boats and a steamship in the background. A man stands on the pier looking toward the water. Buildings and forested shoreline are visible across the bay. Printed captions in Swedish identify the place, and there is cursive handwritten text across the bottom.
